notes: The compiler's question «وسألت محمدا» makes the asked man (محمدا) the first link (rule 5); the compiler himself is not written (owner ruling 1). «بهذا» is not written as a link: it names the matn, not a transmitter.
«وإنما هو عن أبي هريرة، موقوف» names a different source for the same hadith: a variant group.
The opinions of Companions and jurists after the chain («وقال عثمان بن عفان ...») are the compiler's survey with no transmitter: not chains, left out.
